Frequently Asked Questions

What interior design services do you provide in Hauz Khas?

Space planning, concept design, 3D views, working drawings, material selection, custom furniture, lighting and site supervision for homes, cafés, salons and offices.

Do you design cafés and restaurants?

Yes. Hospitality spaces need seating plans, kitchen coordination, lighting moods and durable finishes, and we plan these together with your operations team.

Can I start with a consultation only?

Yes. A consultation helps you understand layout options and a rough scope before you commit to a full project.

Why choose complete interior design services for a builder floor?

A builder floor has kitchens, wardrobes, bathrooms and ceilings all at once. One team handling design and supervision keeps the finish consistent.
